chunks: 1917 - And Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Ismāʿīl ibn al-Ḥurr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"If the crescent sets before twilight, then it is for one night; and if it sets after twilight, then it is for two nights."

key_terms.الشَّفَقِ: twilight, used here as a point of observation after sunset
key_terms.الْهِلَالُ: the new crescent moon marking the beginning of the lunar month
key_terms.غَابَ: set or disappeared below the horizon

ai.seo_question: How does the setting time of the crescent indicate whether it is one or two nights old?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal indicator for estimating the age of the new crescent based on when it sets relative to twilight. It relates to determining the lunar month, which has significance for fasting and other acts of worship tied to the Islamic calendar.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1917 - Hammad ibn Isa narrated from Isma'il ibn al-Hurr, from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"If the crescent sets before twilight, it is for one night. If it sets after twilight, it is for two nights."
